// The public API of @family-agenda/plugin-protocol, written by `pnpm sdk-api`. Do not edit it by hand.
// src/index.ts
import type { CatalogueEntry, Choice, ConfigField, Health, IngestResult, JsonObject, PluginText, RunContext, SetupProgress, SourcePluginIdentity } from "@family-agenda/source-sdk";
export declare const authorizationHeader = "authorization";
export type PluginDescription = {
    identity: SourcePluginIdentity;
    configuration: {
        version: number;
        fields: (Omit<ConfigField, "choices"> & {
            choices: boolean;
        })[];
        migrations: number[];
    };
    setupSteps: {
        id: string;
        title: PluginText;
        description: PluginText;
        live: boolean;
    }[];
    ingestion: {
        mode: "polling";
        suggestedIntervalSeconds: number;
    } | {
        mode: "push";
    };
    health: Health;
    catalogue: {
        title: PluginText;
        configKey: string;
    } | null;
    sourceAdded: boolean;
    sourceRemoved: boolean;
};
export type Calls = {
    poll: {
        args: [RunContext];
        result: IngestResult;
    };
    sourceAdded: {
        args: [Omit<RunContext, "syncCursor">];
        result: {
            plain: JsonObject;
            secrets: Record<string, string>;
        };
    };
    sourceRemoved: {
        args: [RunContext];
        result: null;
    };
    choices: {
        args: [string, RunContext];
        result: Choice[];
    };
    setupProgress: {
        args: [string, RunContext];
        result: SetupProgress | null;
    };
    catalogueEntries: {
        args: [];
        result: CatalogueEntry[];
    };
    migrate: {
        args: [number, JsonObject];
        result: JsonObject;
    };
};
export type CallName = keyof Calls;
export declare const callNames: readonly CallName[];
export declare function isCallName(name: string): name is CallName;
export type CallFailure = {
    sourceError: "definite" | "temporary" | null;
    message: string;
};
export type CallOutcome<T = unknown> = {
    ok: true;
    value: T;
} | {
    ok: false;
    failure: CallFailure;
};
export declare function failureOf(error: unknown): CallFailure;
export declare function encode(value: unknown): string;
export declare function decode(text: string): unknown;
